close_reason: opinion: Arc clone pattern is correct and idiomatic
description: build_jmap_dispatcher(stores: Arc<JmapStores>) creates StoaHandler{stores} and then calls Arc::clone(&handler) 31 times in the loop. The pattern is: one Arc<StoaHandler> with one Arc<JmapStores> inside it, then 31 Arc::clone of the handler. This is correct and efficient. No change needed — noting it as reviewed.
title: build_jmap_dispatcher takes Arc<JmapStores> by value, StoaHandler clones it — single clone suffices
